svg.title: bhwi embedded in a host application
svg.desc: Isometric view: a host application block in the language's color carries the constant bhwi Rust chip. Wide ribbon arrows show the language's own I/O carrying Transmit payloads out to the device and replies back in, and app code exchanging commands and responses with the chip. Swift, Kotlin, Python and JavaScript blocks take turns while the chip stays.

g.text: Transmit — carried by the host's own I/O
